Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. 1C4RJXN63RW121805.notes: 2024 Jeep Wrangler Willys 4xe Because Apparently Regular Jeeps Werent Complicated Enough VIN: 1C4RJXN63RW121805 Meet the 2024 Jeep Wrangler Willys 4xe, the Jeep for people who want to go off-road, look tough, and still have enough technology to make everyone wonder how a Jeep got this sophisticated. It sits there looking like it's already planning an adventure while you're still trying to decide where you're going for lunch. And then there's the 4xe part. Yes, it's a Jeep with electrification. Because apparently Jeep decided that getting dirty, climbing trails, and splashing through puddles wasn't enough excitement. Now you can do it with some electric technology involved. Perfect for: Taking the scenic route because the normal road is boring Finding mud and somehow bringing all of it home Convincing your friends that you absolutely needed another Jeep Weekend adventures that start with "Let's just see where this road goes" Removing the doors and immediately feeling like you have your life together Parking next to ordinary SUVs and making them feel inadequate Going off-road just because the weather app says it's going to rain Inside, you've got the practicality and technology you need for everyday driving, while the Wrangler's unmistakable personality is always reminding you that this thing was built for more than commuting. The best part? You don't need to be an off-road expert to enjoy it. You can drive it to work Monday through Friday, hit the trails Saturday, and spend Sunday cleaning mud out of places you didn't know existed. It's rugged when you want it, comfortable when you need it, and just ridiculous enough to make driving it a whole lot more fun.

Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe. Rear collision mitigation - It has your back. Rear collision mitigation uses sensors to monitor the area behind you. If it senses an impending crash, it activates certain features to help prevent a collision or reduce the severity of it. Put your worries behind you with rear collision mitigation.

Maybe you fell asleep. Maybe you lost consciousness. No matter how it happens, Unresponsive driver assistant works to help lessen the danger when it does. It slows you down; speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control. Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians.

What this vehicle includes: Safety and Security Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you. Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.

ZFF12YXX000326845.notes: The Ferrari 296 Challenge is the purest expression of the 296 platform, transformed from an extraordinary road car into a purpose built Ferrari racing machine. Developed for the Ferrari Challenge series, it takes the dramatic shape and unmistakable character of the 296 and turns the volume all the way up. Every surface looks sculpted by speed, from the wide stance and aggressive front end to the enormous rear wing and carefully developed aerodynamic bodywork. There is an unmistakable sense of Italian theater to the 296 Challenge. It has the kind of presence that only a Ferrari race car can deliver, combining beautiful proportions with an attitude that makes its intentions immediately clear. Open the door and the road going luxuries give way to a focused competition cockpit, complete with a racing seat, harnesses, roll cage, steering wheel, and all the equipment expected of a serious machine destined for the circuit. But beneath all the aggression is the same passion for design and engineering that has defined Ferrari for generations. The 296 Challenge is not simply about going fast. It is about the experience of driving a Ferrari at its most concentrated, where every input matters and every lap becomes an occasion. The sound, the smell of the brakes and tires, the sensation of the chassis working beneath you, and the sight of that unmistakable Prancing Horse on the steering wheel all combine to create something wonderfully theatrical. This is Ferrari without compromise. A competition car born in Maranello, shaped by decades of racing heritage, and created for drivers who want to experience the Prancing Horse exactly as it was meant to be experienced: on a racetrack, at full attack, with nothing between the driver and the machine. For more information on this Ferrari 296 Challenge car call one of our Ferrari Specialists today at 847.295.6560

Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. Maybe you lost consciousness. No matter how it happens, Unresponsive driver assistant works to help lessen the danger when it does. It detects prolonged driver unresponsiveness, automatically bringing the vehicle to a stop and turning on the hazard lights. If equipped, emergency services will also be contacted. Unresponsive driver assistant is safety that never sleeps. Safety and Security Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Safety and Security Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe. Technology and Telematics Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system.
